A striking double exposure: the tight profile silhouette of a human head whose interior holds two skies. The left half churns with boiling storm clouds and forks of lightning; the right half dissolves seamlessly into a serene golden sunrise over a calm ocean, a flock of birds escaping through the outline of the eye.
Style: Double exposure fine-art photography, gradient monochrome-to-color, minimalist.
Composition: Profile head-and-shoulders on the right third, immense negative space to the left; the inner ocean horizon line continues perfectly into the outer background sky.
Lighting: Split-lighting metaphor — cold storm tonality on the left melting into warm golden sunrise tonality on the right, meeting in a luminous seam through the eye.
Adjectives: turbulent, cathartic, dual, poetic, luminous.
